title: Käsespätzle mit Apfelbutter
description: A German classic spätzle dish topped with a sweet and crunchy apple butter and crispy onions.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Add the spätzle and cook until they float to the surface.
In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until caramelized.
In a separate bowl, mix together the flour and brown sugar.
Add the mixture to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the apple butter and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the cooked spätzle to the skillet and toss with the apple butter mixture.
